title: Points Activity Courtesy on Delivery Claims Found-Parcel Charges
content:
Under Delivery Claims, a customer whose Marlowe Rewards membership has been earning points over the past year receives a courtesy on a found-parcel charge.

**Courtesy.** The engagement courtesy depends on the points earnings posted to the customer's membership in the trailing 12 calendar months: four or more earnings give 5%, two or three give 2%, and fewer give none.

Counted: each points-earned entry on the customer's Marlowe Rewards points ledger whose posting date falls in the 12 calendar months up to today. Bonuses, reversals, conversions and forfeitures are other kinds of entry and are not earnings.

| Points earnings posted in the trailing 12 months | Engagement courtesy |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | 5% |
| 2 or 3 | 2% |
| 0 or 1 | none |

*Hypothetical:* a member whose ledger shows three points earnings and one birthday bonus in the past year has three earnings: 2%. A fourth earning posted within the window would raise the courtesy to 5%.
